Glad I caught you while you were in town. Would love to see more of these comparisons, especially between up-and-coming cities. · I get the Philadelphia/Chicago comparison, because Philadelphia has a big city vibe to it, but it’s cut from the same cloth as Boston. I love both cities, have lived in both. Chicago is probably my favorite between the two but you cannot go wrong with either. If your family and friends are along the NE corridor that probably gives the edge to Philly.
